title: Launch Setup & Purchase Flow Updates (v4.1.1)
summary: App selection and paywall clarity improved, so setup feels more guided and launch decisions are easier.

bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Selected apps now stay pinned while you build or edit your block list
- Shield editing actions now match the rest of the app controls
- Yearly Pro pricing is clearer with the monthly equivalent up front

## Improvements

- Terms and Privacy dialogs are shorter, scrollable, and easier to close
- Small launch polish across paywall, Shield, and onboarding flows

## Why this matters

Launch Setup & Purchase Flow Updates (v4.1.1) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Selected apps now stay pinned while you build or edit your block list gets a little more room to breathe.
- Shield editing actions now match the rest of the app controls gets a little more room to breathe.
- Yearly Pro pricing is clearer with the monthly equivalent up front gets a little more room to breathe.
- Terms and Privacy dialogs are shorter, scrollable, and easier to close gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
